description: Limits request rate per client IP or authenticated identity. Mitigates brute force attacks, credential stuffing, and application-level denial of service from single-source attackers. Does not protect against distributed attacks across many source IPs.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Per-IP request throttling caps the rate at which any single source can consume application resources (connections, threads, CPU), preventing single-source request flooding from exhausting capacity for other clients
cvss_vector_impacts.evidence_basis: Effective against single-source flooding and automated scanning; ineffective against distributed DoS (botnet traffic from thousands of IPs stays under per-IP limits), application-complexity DoS (single expensive request), and connection-level exhaustion (Slowloris)
conditions: Attack originates from a single source IP or small number of IPs
Attack relies on request volume, not request complexity
Rate limiting is configured in blocking mode with appropriate thresholds

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Per-IP throttling limits authentication attempts to a rate that makes dictionary and brute force attacks from a single source impractical (e.g., 5 attempts/minute vs thousands/second)
cvss_vector_impacts.evidence_basis: Effective against single-source brute force and automated credential testing tools; ineffective against distributed credential stuffing using residential proxy rotation or botnet IPs, where each source stays under the per-IP limit
conditions: Brute force originates from a single source IP or small number of IPs
Attacker is not using credential stuffing with known-valid pairs (few attempts needed)
Rate limiting applies to authentication endpoints specifically

verification.method: Verify rate limiting is configured in the web server or reverse proxy

steps.description: Define a rate-limiting shared memory zone keyed by client IP (10m zone holds ~160k IPs, limit to 10 requests/second per IP)
Apply the rate limit to a server or location block with a burst allowance of 20 requests (replace <server_conf> with the target config file path)
Test nginx configuration syntax before reload
Reload nginx to apply the rate limiting configuration

remediation.name: Apache httpd rate limiting with mod_evasive
remediation.precondition: httpd -v 2>&1 | grep -qi apache || apache2 -v 2>&1 | grep -qi apache

steps.description: Install mod_evasive (RHEL/CentOS — available from EPEL; on Debian/Ubuntu use libapache2-mod-evasive)
steps.command: dnf install -y mod_evasive || apt-get install -y libapache2-mod-evasive
steps.undo: dnf remove -y mod_evasive || apt-get remove -y libapache2-mod-evasive

steps.description: Configure mod_evasive with per-IP request thresholds (50 requests per page per second, 5 concurrent requests per site, 10s blocking period)
steps.command:
printf '<IfModule mod_evasive24.c>
  DOSHashTableSize 3097
  DOSPageCount 50
  DOSSiteCount 100
  DOSPageInterval 1
  DOSSiteInterval 1
  DOSBlockingPeriod 10
</IfModule>
' > /etc/httpd/conf.d/mod_evasive.conf
systemctl reload httpd || systemctl reload apache2

steps.description: Install the IIS IP and Domain Restrictions feature if not already present
Enable Dynamic IP Restrictions to deny by concurrent requests (max 10 concurrent connections per IP)
steps.command: Set-WebConfigurationProperty -Filter 'system.webServer/security/dynamicIpSecurity/denyByConcurrentRequests' -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\Default Web Site' -Name enabled -Value $true; Set-WebConfigurationProperty -Filter 'system.webServer/security/dynamicIpSecurity/denyByConcurrentRequests' -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\Default Web Site' -Name maxConcurrentRequests -Value 10

steps.description: Enable Dynamic IP Restrictions to deny by request rate (max 25 requests per 10-second interval per IP)
steps.command: Set-WebConfigurationProperty -Filter 'system.webServer/security/dynamicIpSecurity/denyByRequestRate' -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\Default Web Site' -Name enabled -Value $true; Set-WebConfigurationProperty -Filter 'system.webServer/security/dynamicIpSecurity/denyByRequestRate' -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\Default Web Site' -Name maxRequests -Value 25; Set-WebConfigurationProperty -Filter 'system.webServer/security/dynamicIpSecurity/denyByRequestRate' -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\Default Web Site' -Name requestIntervalInMilliseconds -Value 10000

references.source: Microsoft — Dynamic IP Restrictions in IIS
